detail.createInvoiceBody: A draft invoice addressed to {{name}} will be created, pre-filled with this gig's booking fee and details. You will be taken to the new invoice to review it.

deal.title: Deal

dealTypeHelp.flat_fee: A fixed guaranteed amount, with no revenue from ticket sales.
dealTypeHelp.guarantee: A guaranteed fee with potential upside from ticket sales. Choose how the fee and ticket share relate under Guarantee variant.
dealTypeHelp.door_deal: A percentage of ticket revenue after the break-even point, with no guaranteed fee.

guaranteeVariantHelp.plus: The guaranteed fee plus a percentage of ticket revenue after break-even. Venue costs can be included in break-even.
guaranteeVariantHelp.versus: Either the guaranteed fee or the artist's percentage of ticket revenue — whichever is higher.

deal.ticketSplitHelp: The artist's share of ticket revenue first, the venue or promoter's second. The two always add up to 100%.
deal.includeVenueCosts: Include venue costs in the break-even calculation
deal.venueCostsHelp: Production costs recouped from ticket revenue at break-even, such as venue rental.
deal.expectedVisitorsHelp: Used to simulate the potential upside.
deal.netTicketPriceHelp: The price the door takes per ticket, excl. service fees — the basis for every calculation below. If it includes VAT, set the ticket VAT % under Taxes.

commission.title: Commission
commission.percentageHelp: Calculated from the nett fee (gross fee minus costs).

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.generalVatHelp: The rate an invoice generated from this gig is billed at. Leave blank for the default rate ({{rate}}%).
taxes.ticketVatHelp: The VAT the venue charges on tickets, contained in the nett ticket price. Every ticket calculation runs on the price with it taken out.
taxes.copyrightHelp: Copyright / PRS deducted from ticket revenue after ticket VAT. Leave blank to ignore it.

paidByHelp.artist_agency: Deducted from the gross fee before the booking fee is calculated, so both sides bear a share through the reduced base.
paidByHelp.artist: Deducted only from what is due to the artist. The booking fee is unaffected.
paidByHelp.agency: Deducted only from what is due to the booker. The amount due to the artist is unaffected.

breakdown.ticketRevenue_one: The artist’s {{percentage}}% share of the {{count}} ticket sold so far.
breakdown.ticketRevenue_other: The artist’s {{percentage}}% share of the {{count}} tickets sold so far.
breakdown.ticketRevenueUnknown: No tickets sold have been entered yet.
breakdown.ticketRevenueFlatFee: A flat fee takes no share of ticket revenue.
breakdown.grossFee: Guaranteed fee {{guarantee}} plus {{tickets}} earned on the tickets sold so far.
breakdown.percentageOfNett: {{percentage}}% of the nett fee minus the booking fee ({{base}}).
breakdown.fixedAmount: A fixed amount, entered as agreed.
breakdown.dueToBookerWithCosts: Booking fee {{bookingFee}} plus commission {{commission}}, minus {{costs}} in costs paid by the agency.
breakdown.dueToArtistInclusive: The nett fee minus commission and the booking fee, which is split out of the gross fee.
breakdown.dueToArtistWithCosts: Minus {{costs}} in costs paid by the artist.

tickets.title: Ticket upside
tickets.actualUpside: Upside on tickets sold so far: {{amount}}.
tickets.vatCorrectedPrice: Ticket VAT of {{percentage}}% comes off first, so every calculation runs on {{price}} a ticket.
tickets.copyrightCorrectedPrice: Copyright / PRS of {{percentage}}% comes off after ticket VAT, leaving {{price}} a ticket for the deal calculation.
tickets.flatFeeNote: A flat fee takes no share of ticket revenue.

breakdown.sold: Tickets sold so far, against the venue capacity.
breakdown.expected: The artist’s {{percentage}}% share at the expected number of visitors.
breakdown.potential: The artist’s {{percentage}}% share at full capacity — the ceiling for this deal.
breakdown.flat_fee: A flat fee has no break-even point.
breakdown.guarantee: Ticket revenue follows the selected guarantee variant.
breakdown.door_deal: Ticket revenue has to cover the venue costs before the artist’s share starts.

guaranteeVariants.plus: Ticket revenue has to cover the gross fee, and the venue costs when those are included, before the artist’s share starts.
guaranteeVariants.versus: Nothing is recouped — the deal simply pays whichever is higher, the guaranteed fee or the artist’s full share of the door.
